settings.name: Qurat ul ain siddiqui
settings.body: I had a wonderful experience at this makeup institute. Maggie was an amazing trainer — very talented, supportive, patient, and passionate about teaching. Her way of explaining makeup techniques was professional, creative, and easy to understand, which made learning enjoyable and inspiring. The classes were hands-on, well organised, and helped me improve my confidence and skills in both makeup and hairstyling. Maggie always encouraged students to do their best and created a welcoming learning environment. I would highly recommend this institute to anyone wanting to build a career in makeup, beauty, or hairstyling. It's a great place to learn, grow, and express creativity.

settings.name: Anuradha Dharmadasa
settings.body: I recently completed both the Nail and Makeup courses at Tamarua Beauty Academy, and I honestly couldn't be happier with my experience. Both courses were absolutely amazing and exceeded my expectations. The Nail course, taught by Thea, was so well structured. She is patient, supportive, and incredibly talented. I learned so much and felt confident every step of the way. The Makeup course with Maggie was just as incredible. She is knowledgeable, passionate, and made every lesson enjoyable and easy to follow. I've gained so many new skills that I can now confidently use. Thanks to this amazing training, I now run my own nail studio and hope to start makeup services as well very soon. A huge thank you to Thea and Maggie for their guidance, encouragement, and dedication. You both made this journey so special for me. I highly recommend Tamarua Beauty Academy to anyone who wants to start or grow in the beauty industry. Truly a wonderful learning experience!

settings.name: Apoorva Bhardwaj
settings.body: I'm so grateful for my experience with Maggie at Tamarua Beauty School 💖 From the moment I started, Maggie was incredibly kind, supportive, and genuinely passionate about teaching. She creates such a welcoming environment that makes learning feel easy and enjoyable. This has honestly been the best beauty school I've attended. Maggie's knowledge is amazing — she explains everything so clearly and shares real, practical insights from the industry. I also loved that we worked with current, market-relevant products, which made the training feel very up-to-date and valuable. I had the best time learning makeup here, and I'm so glad I chose Tamarua Beauty School. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking to start or grow their journey in the beauty industry ✨

settings.name: Ashleigh Conibeer
settings.body: Maggie was incredible and an exceptional teacher! I learn best through observation, and this course was ideal for me. Since completing it, I've had numerous work experience opportunities. I now run my own successful business and have received several awards in the industry. I've also connected with many wonderful students through TBA, and we collaborate now! I highly recommend this course.

settings.name: kamal preet
settings.body: I recently completed the makeup and hairstyling course at Tamarua Beauty Academy, and I must say, it was an incredible experience! I drove almost two hours each way from Rye for nearly three months, and it was absolutely worth it. Despite having closer academies, I knew this was the right place for me. A huge thank you to Maggie for her patience and exceptional skill level. The way she runs the business is truly impressive – she's a boss in every sense of the word! Additionally, my trainers, Maggie and Cassie, were both amazing and incredibly supportive throughout the course. For anyone considering a career in beauty, I highly recommend this school. I loved every moment of my time here! I also appreciated the flexibility they offered, especially when there were times I couldn't make it. They were more than accommodating, providing live streams and allowing me to come back to finish off classes. Thank you, thank you, thank you to everyone at Tamarua Beauty Academy!

settings.name: Jacqueline Mercieca
settings.body: Just attended Tamarua beauty academy with my daughter for a mum /tween make up class. We had such a fun and interactive experience. Maggie is so talented and educated in all things beauty! This is definitely a MUST do with your daughters, my daughter was totally in her element there today. Highly recommend giving Maggie a visit!

settings.name: Jordon Beckwith
settings.body: My daughter did the tweens holiday course and had a great time, and learnt a lot from Maggie. She wants to do more courses and continue to learn from Maggie at Tamarua Beauty Academy

settings.name: Sedra
settings.body: I honestly can't say enough good things about Tamaru Beauty Academy and my amazing trainer, Maggie! From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed, supported, and truly cared for. Maggie isn't just a trainer — she's a mentor, a cheerleader, and a true inspiration. She teaches with so much passion and patience, and she makes sure every single student understands and feels confident before moving on. Her positive energy and kindness made every class something to look forward to. She always took the time to guide me, encourage me, and push me to believe in myself. Because of her, I've grown so much — not just in my skills, but in my confidence too. Tamaru Beauty Academy has such a warm, friendly atmosphere, and Maggie makes it feel like a family. I'm so grateful for everything I've learned and for the love and support I've received. Thank you, Maggie, for being such a beautiful soul and an incredible trainer. You've truly changed my journey for the better! 💕✨

settings.name: Candice
settings.body: At Tamara Academy, you truly get a one-stop experience for all your beauty courses. From the very first phone call with Maggie, her warm and welcoming voice reassured me that I had found the right place. When I arrived at her studio, the beauty and calming atmosphere instantly took my breath away. Maggie is incredibly kind, easy to talk to, and patiently listens to and answers every question. Because of her in professionalism and genuine care, I decided to complete four courses with her: Lash Extensions, Facials, Makeup, and Nail Technology. Her teachers are also wonderful—supportive, knowledgeable, and friendly. Thank you, Maggie 💖 I am truly grateful for the amazing experience.

settings.name: Jess Carolina
settings.body: Thank you Maggie for such an amazing experience during the makeup course! Over the past few weeks, I've learned so much from Maggie. She is honestly the sweetest, kindest, and most supportive, always taking the time to answer all of my questions and share her insights. I've grown so much in confidence and skill thanks to Maggie. I couldn't recommend Maggie enough to anyone wanting to start their makeup journey!

settings.name: essra hammoud
settings.body: I had the best experience at Tamaru Beauty Academy! The makeup course was so detailed and hands-on — I learned everything from basic techniques to advanced glam looks. The trainers were patient, professional, and truly passionate about what they do. The atmosphere was friendly and motivating, and I left feeling confident in my skills. Highly recommend it to anyone who wants to start a career in makeup or just improve their artistry!

settings.name: Gabby Lizzy
settings.body: I have been wanting to attend this school for a very long time, and I'm thrilled they recently added day makeup courses! I recently completed the Express Day Makeup Course, which runs two days a week over four weeks, and it has been an amazing experience. Maggie, our instructor, is one of the best in the industry. Her knowledge and expertise have taught me so much, and her passion for makeup truly shines through in her teaching. I feel incredibly inspired and excited to open my own business in the future. I can't wait to return to take the Hair Course soon! Thank you for such a fantastic learning opportunity!

settings.name: Marisa Torrealba
settings.body: I absolutely love Tamarua Beauty Academy! I began my journey here in 2017 with the makeup course and recently returned to complete facials and waxing to enhance my business. My kids have also taken several courses, and my husband just finished the barbering course. The trainers are exceptional, and the atmosphere is fantastic. Maggie and the team have always been incredibly accommodating and supportive. I highly recommend this school for anyone looking to grow their skills!

settings.name: Antoinette Azzopardi
settings.body: I have been a model at Tamarua Beauty Academy several times, and my daughter has taken a few courses as well. The atmosphere is always friendly, the team are amazing and incredibly knowledgeable. Maggie, the owner, has gone above and beyond …

settings.name: Briana MacDonald
settings.body: Just wrapped up the 12 week Pro Nails Course at the TBA and it was such a great experience! The in-person learning was super practical and really engaging, and our teacher Lily was super warm - so encouraging, patient, and knowledgeable. Big shout out to Maggie, the founder, for creating such a supportive and empowering space. I left feeling confident, inspired, and ready to start my nail journey. Highly recommend to anyone keen to level up their skills in a fun, supportive environment!

settings.name: Alessia Ferrante
settings.body: I've learnt so much from Maggie at Tamarua Beauty Academy, and I honestly couldn't recommend her enough! She's such a sweet, professional, and passionate teacher who truly loves what she does. You can tell right away how knowledgeable she is — from explaining looks to products and more! What I loved most is how supportive she is — she's your ultimate hype woman! She makes you feel confident in your work, even when you're still learning, and creates such a positive, encouraging environment in class. Every lesson was fun, hands-on, and filled with useful tips and tricks that I'll carry with me forever. If you're thinking about studying makeup, this is the place to do it. I walked away not just with new skills, but with real confidence and excitement to start my journey in the beauty world!

settings.name: Brianna Brooksby
settings.body: Maggie & Lily are genuinely the most loveliest people I've ever met, they are so encouraging with everything. I couldn't recommend going here enough !! I just finished my 12 week nail course & they were able to accommodate to me & my plans when I was going away. Thank you Maggie & lily I hope to see you again next year🥹💞💞

settings.name: Gonz Torrealba
settings.body: I did my barbering course at Tamarua beauty academy. The course was fantastic and the team looked after us and provided all their knowledge. Maggie is the best, very welcoming and always with a smile on her face, she is always willing to help. All my family has now done courses at Tamarua and will not hesitate in recommending Tamarua to anyone who is willing to get an exceptional experience.

settings.name: Louise Chapman
settings.body: I cannot recommend Tamarua Beauty Academy enough! I trained with Maggie in make up all the way back in 2018 and hair 2020/2021. I have a successful freelance business with returning clients. Still until this year (2025) do I get support from my trainers and encouragement! For me this is a vital role in my success (as I can often feel that I am not good enough) Their support gives me the will to continue in the field and so I continue to improve by practise. This has a business owner that cares, and this shows in everything, from the detailing in the course, the building which feels warm and is beautifully styled, to the great communication and not to mention the way i was taught! I often found myself smiling because Maggie is so funny which also keeps the anxiety levels down if you are a perfectionist like me!. Thank you for all you do!

settings.name: Devorah Grinblat
settings.body: I have been a two time student at Tamarua Beauty Academy because I absolutely loved the first course so much! I have done facials, and am currently completing the nail course and am thoroughly enjoying it. The teachers are lovely, skilled and caring and will answer any questions I have. The learning environment is super positive and enjoyable. I found that Tamarua go above and beyond other training institutions as they offer in person training, which is rare to find in this new age online environment. Being able to do in person classes means I can be more hands on and learn with teachers there in person for guidance and to see my work and skill development. I highly recommend this beauty academy to anyone looking to upskill!

settings.name: Mary Monaco
settings.body: I can't say enough amazing things about Tamarua Beauty Academy! From the moment I walked through the doors, I felt welcomed, empowered, and inspired. The educators are not only incredibly knowledgeable and experienced, but they genuinely care about each student's growth and success. The curriculum is top-tier—modern, hands-on, and aligned with current industry trends. Whether you're pursuing a career in hair, makeup, spray tanning, barbering, nails, this academy gives you everything you need to thrive in the beauty industry. The facilities are state-of-the-art, and the real-world training opportunities gave me the confidence to start working with clients even before graduation. What truly sets this academy apart is the supportive, positive environment. It's more than a school—it's a community. I left with lifelong skills, a strong portfolio, and connections that continue to help me in my career. If you're serious about turning your passion into a profession, Tamarua Beauty Academy is the place to be. It changed my life, and I know it can do the same for you!

settings.name: Lili O
settings.body: I recently completed the professional makeup course, and it exceeded all my expectations! The curriculum was well-structured, covering everything from foundational techniques to advanced artistry. My instructor Maggie who is also the academy founder was not only knowledgeable but also incredibly supportive, offering personalized feedback and sharing industry secrets that you can't find in textbooks. The hands-on practice sessions were invaluable, allowing me to refine my skills with real-time guidance. I particularly appreciated the focus on both creativity and precision, which has given me the confidence to pursue my passion for makeup professionally. The course also provided great insights into the business side of the industry, which was a fantastic bonus. I now feel well-equipped to build a successful career in makeup artistry. I highly recommend this course to anyone serious about taking their makeup skills to the next level!

settings.name: Manjeet Vishal
settings.body: I have been attending Tamarua Beauty Academy for the past three months, and I couldn't be happier with my experience! I've already booked several additional courses and plan to continue my education here for the next year. The teachers are incredibly friendly and approachable, making it easy to learn and grow. I've gained so much knowledge during my time here, and I'm excited to further my education and eventually open my own business. One of the things I love most about the academy is the TBA Alumni page. It's a fantastic resource where I can ask as many questions as I want, and I also receive valuable business advice to help set me up for the future. Overall, I feel supported and empowered on my journey, and I can't wait to see where this education takes me!

settings.name: Kaylan Oz
settings.body: I honestly couldn't recommend The Tamarua Beauty Academy enough! I recently completed the Beginners Makeup Course and the Advanced/Pro Makeup course and genuinely gained so much confidence and technique all thanks to Maggie and the amazing teachers at TBA. The Owner Maggie goes above and beyond for her students, ensuring that they are well prepared for once they finish the course and continues to assist them long after the course is finished. I'm so so grateful that I Found TBA and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking to get into the industry.

settings.name: Talwinder Sambi
settings.body: TBA is honestly the place to be n learn all the beauty skills. I did the make up n lash extensions course n I had the best time, Maggie was really good n helpful n taught me heaps of skills. I did the make up course couple years ago n I still remember the things Maggie taught me n those skill has come really handy. I just finished my lash course n it was really good, enjoyed it a lot n it was very hands on. Maggie's just the best n would highly recommend doing your course at TBA.

settings.name: inder gill
settings.body: I did nail tech course at TBA. I loved the course and Really happy with all the guides through the course, learnt so many things that I didn't know and looking forward to starting my own business soon . Thank you very much.

settings.name: Tina Stent
settings.body: I have had the pleasure of dealing with Maggie from a professional and personal perspective for over 10 years. She is not only a talented and renowned make-up artist but also an amazing teacher. Her courses are perfect for those looking to enter the industry as their own business or as someone who wants to have the knowledge and skills to be able to self apply make-up professionally...either way engaging Maggie will be a rewarding and positive experience.

settings.name: Saima Tariq
settings.body: I have successfully earned both beginner and advanced certificates in all three courses offered at Tamara Beauty Academy: makeup, facials, and hairstyling. My journey at this academy has spanned nearly seven enriching months, during which I've had the pleasure of forming meaningful connections with not only my director, Maggie, but also with the entire faculty, Jodie and Casey. I consider enrolling here one of the best decisions I've ever made, given the exceptional learning experience it has provided me. Throughout these courses, I have acquired a wealth of knowledge encompassing both fundamental principles and cutting-edge techniques that align perfectly with today's beauty trends and consumer preferences. For anyone harbouring an interest in the world of beauty, I encourage them to consider pursuing their certification through Tamarua Beauty Academy. In my opinion, there exists no better academy that offers such a diverse range of courses while fostering a supportive community of passionate individuals. Tamara Beauty Academy has truly provided me with the best hands-on experience, and I am immensely grateful for the opportunity to learn and grow here.

settings.name: Maria Nasrallah
settings.alt: Maria Nasrallah — Tamarua Beauty Academy student success story
settings.body: Maria says that the education that she received at the Tamarua Beauty Academy was amazing, and certainly helped her succeed in many forms. One of them being having her work published in three overseas publications using the skills that she learnt at the academy as well as opportunities to do more editorial work.

settings.name: Jolie Nguyen
settings.alt: Jolie Nguyen — Tamarua Beauty Academy student success story
settings.body: Jolie is a professional Hair & Makeup Artist based in the West side of Melbourne. After 5 years free-lancing, she has gained valuable experience and confidence to run her own business as "Jolie Artistry". Her business is all about providing Hair styling and Makeup Service for all clients for different special occasions from weddings to private celebrations.

settings.name: Sarah Meilak
settings.alt: Sarah Meilak — Tamarua Beauty Academy student success story
settings.body: Sarah is the owner of "Beauty By Sarah Meilak" from the western suburbs. She has a great range of different beauty services including eyelash extensions, facials, hair and makeup. She says she decided to learn through the Tamarua Beauty Academy because of their amazing reputation, the small class sizes, the hands-on-learning and the education that is provided.
